batch_policy.batch_size: 40 (B1 = all 43 source candidates as one domain batch)
batch_policy.re_ask_note: Entries with confidence < 0.55 (hdfs/sftp remote-repo candidates) were re-checked once against the real repo code (hdfs_artifact_repo.py, sftp_artifact_repo.py) during batch B9/B2 review; uncertainty was confirmed and classification kept as candidate rather than re-classified.

inputs.code_context: per-candidate +/-2 line context extracted from mlflow_vuln source tree (candidate_context.txt, 341 candidates)

prompt_contract.system: Classify candidate APIs for CWE pass 1 (path traversal); prefer conservative recall; mark sanitizers only with concrete evidence; roles: source/sink/sanitizer/summary/none.

Real pre-use guard on the artifact upload path: verify_artifact_path raises for any artifact_path where path_not_unique holds (normpath differs from input, equals '.', starts with '..' or '/'); applied at LocalArtifactRepository.log_artifact/log_artifacts entry (local_artifact_repo.py:27,48) and HttpArtifactRepository.log_artifact (http_artifact_repo.py:19) - i.e. before the join + copyfile. It does NOT guard download/list/delete paths.

Underlying validation predicate: norm = posixpath.normpath(name); returns True when norm != name, norm == '.', norm.startswith('..') or norm.startswith('/'). Correctly rejects non-normalized, dot-prefixed and absolute inputs, so no traversal-shaped artifact_path passes verify_artifact_path.
